evidence: Owner account, attributed and not independently established: on 25 June 2025 the Grandson says he was alone in a cabin at a Welsh settlement in Argentina, wearing British military uniform, researching Great House Farm and raising concerns by phone, email and YouTube. The dramatization does not invent dialogue, recipients, private correspondence or a precise location.

The July computer scene is an explicitly labelled dramatization. It does not identify the person, institution, publisher or physical upload location. The project chronology records the 25 July 2025 online-publication date for the separate 4GXmR7mAas0 viewing copy; this does not show who uploaded it or where.

The supplied Wales at Six player vF25-sLZXaM is a separate source clip, played from 19:48. Its precise relationship to the separate 5 December 1988 Wales at Six demolition report being sought is not assumed by this scene.

The 4GXmR7mAas0 item is described in project evidence record EV-0083 / GHF-E113 as a YouTube secondary viewing host of ITV Wales/ITV Archive material. The accessible English captions are machine-generated/extracted from the viewing copy and are not treated as provenance. The link between this copy and NLW Watch and Listen item 507738 is unconfirmed.

NLW catalogue item 507738 is separately described as 'Eviction News Material, 30 November 1988'. Its catalogue note says 'Not viewed'; the record does not establish that it is the same item as the 4GXmR7mAas0 viewing copy or the separate 5 December Wales at Six report. The 25 July 2025 date is the project's recorded online-publication chronology for the viewing copy, not a broadcast, disclosure, catalogue-creation or transfer date.

The owner's identification of the child in the first ten seconds of the selected 4GXmR7mAas0 clip as Mary Buckler, daughter of Branwen, aged three in 1988, and the description of household furniture being loaded are attributed to the owner. The supplied caption record does not independently identify the child. Depict loading/preparation only, not completed demolition. This child is distinct from Mary (Nancy) Buckler in the earlier chronology.

A calendar then advances to July, accompanied by an explicitly labelled, anonymous dramatization of a person at a computer in Wales. The supplied Wales at Six clip is played from 19:48. The sequence then plays only the first ten seconds of the separate ITV Wales/HTV Wales viewing copy selected by the owner. The project chronology records 25 July 2025 as the online-publication date for that second viewing copy; it is not a broadcast or disclosure date. The uploader, upload location and relationship to National Library of Wales catalogue item 507738 are not established, and no causal link between the June account and either online item is asserted.

cy.title: Dau ddyddiad, darn o archif a chyfrif ar wahân
cy.logline: Mae'r dilyniant olaf yn agor gyda chyfrif y Ŵyr o 25 Mehefin 2025 yn yr Ariannin, a briodolir iddo ar wahân, yna mae'n dangos person dienw wrth gyfrifiadur yng Nghymru mewn dramateiddiad sydd wedi'i labelu'n glir. Daw i ben gyda darn pennawd Wales at Six y mae ei dudalen uwchlwytho yn dangos 25 Gorffennaf 2025, ac yna deg eiliad gyntaf fideo ar wahân y Ŵyr yn unig. Nid yw'r cofnodion yn sefydlu pwy a gyhoeddodd, ble y digwyddodd y naill uwchlwythiad na'r llall, ai'r un eitem yw'r fideos, nac unrhyw gysylltiad achosol rhwng digwyddiadau Mehefin a Gorffennaf. es.title: Dos fechas, un fragmento de archivo y un relato separado
es.logline: La secuencia final comienza con el relato atribuido por separado al Nieto sobre el 25 de junio de 2025 en Argentina; después muestra a una persona anónima ante un ordenador en Gales en una dramatización claramente identificada. Termina con un fragmento de titulares de Wales at Six cuya página de publicación muestra el 25 de julio de 2025, seguido únicamente de los primeros diez segundos del vídeo separado del Nieto. Los registros no establecen quién pulsó publicar, dónde tuvo lugar ninguna de las cargas, si los vídeos son el mismo elemento ni una relación causal entre los hechos de junio y julio. (traducción automática)
